title: Good dance lesson
text: This was a good dance lesson that adapted to the level of my family members. In particular, she was very encouraging as my husband struggled to remember the moves. It is important to recognize this is a dance lesson and does not provide any background / information about the history of flamenco.
author: Stephanie_M

title: Great fun factor
text: Very funny, all in Spanish, we didn't understand everything with words but through the movements performed. Also got the floral hairpins as a gift. For girls trip definitely recommended!!
author: 53aleksandrat

title: So much fun!
text:
I went on a bachelorette trip with friends; it was one of our most fun activities. None of us danced flamenco before and our teacher was very patient. She helped us and explained the steps very well.
Besides, she was very professional!
Highly recommend it if you want a different and fun experience (even if you don't know how to dance!).
author: Passport52951922752

title: Fun Flamenco afternoon
text: We were a group of 12 ladies on a hen do.   It was such fun and we all Really enjoyed ourselves and managed to put a little routine together ant the  end.   Highly recommend this experience.   We all enjoyed ourselves so much.    Definitely recommend hiring the shoes and skirts
author: jogalong123

title: 3 boys danced flamenco
text: Alera was delightful! Our family of 5 (3 boys) did a choreographed flamenco number. Best experience ever!
author: Maya_S

title: Perfect for a big group of girls
text: Esther was very responsive and communicative. We had a really fun class and learnt a lot. It was a perfect addition to our bachelorette weekend.
author: Elizabeth_G

title: To do with family
text: Flamenco is a wonder, we were taught to dance by rumbas, specifically a music of Siempre Así. Highly recommended to do as a family
author: carmeni685

title: Funny.
text: We visited Seville in September 2021. An essential experience is learning flamenco. We liked the whole family, the best, the teacher, very patient and fun
author: B242PDfernandop

title: A great time with the family 🤩🤩🤩
text: We booked a family class, we all liked even my husband not necessarily convinced at the base, a big thank you to Laura, who knew how to make this lesson fun for my daughters (6 and 8 years) and very informative, I recommend 200%, another way to discover flamenco culture. The booking and organization were very efficient and fast, we were even able to have the course in French 👌un Big THANKS for this beautiful experience 👍👍👍
author: Alexsaya

title: Enjoy
text: I loved the experience, I went with my daughter and enjoyed it a lot, the teacher is a charm, adapted the class to our level, making everything seem simple. Recommended 100%
author: Tricia7dom
